Maria (Partnerships): Quick sync — we need the final list of credentials + signed NDA links for AWS/GCP/Azure onboarding. Who's owning artifact naming and upload? cc @Amy @Josh
Amy (Marketplace Ops): I can own AWS artifacts. Will upload to s3://redwood-marketplace/ami-manifests. Need the cross-account IAM role ARN from infra. @devops-bot can you kick off the grant?
devops-bot: Request created: infra ticket MKP-342 for cross-account role and bucket policy. ETA 2 business days.
Josh (Legal): NDA_v3_signed.pdf uploaded to Drive -> Partnerships/Marketplace/Legal. We also need DUNS + billing address for publisher enrollment. @Sudha can you confirm billing address?
Sudha (Product): Billing address is corporate: 1234 Redwood Ct, San Francisco, CA 94107. I'll DM the DUNS number to @Josh.
Maria (Partnerships): For GCP publisher profile we also need support email + 1024x1024 logo PNG. Amy, can you drop logos in the drive folder? Also we need the trial SKU mapping doc (how trial seats map to billing SKUs).
Amy (Marketplace Ops): Logo export done — will upload to Drive. Draft trial-SKU mapping pushed to a private gist: https://gist.github.com/amy/marketplace-sku-map (will add access).
Maria (Partnerships): Propose standard artifact filename pattern: redwood-inference-{cloud}-{region}-{version}.{ext} e.g. redwood-inference-aws-us-west-2-v1.2.0-ami.json — thoughts?
Josh (Legal): Name pattern ok, avoid embedding any PII. Instead of including license text in filename, put license_sha256 in manifest.
Amy (Marketplace Ops): Manifest template I'll use:
```
{
  "name": "redwood-inference",
  "cloud": "aws",
  "region": "us-west-2",
  "version": "1.2.0",
  "artifact_url": "s3://redwood-marketplace/redwood-inference-aws-us-west-2-v1.2.0-ami.json",
  "license_sha256": "abc123..."
}
```
Maria (Partnerships): Azure requires package signing cert CN and a contact email on the publisher profile. @Leo who owns the certs?
Leo (Security): Reach out to certs-admin@redwood.com. I'll provision the public key to our Key Vault and share the CN. ETA tomorrow morning.
Amy (Marketplace Ops): I'll start the uploads once infra confirms role + Leo confirms cert. Will post links when done.
Maria (Partnerships): Deadline: have artifacts, NDA, and trial-SKU mapping uploaded and shared by EOD Wednesday. If you hit blockers, flag them here so we can escalate. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
